goal: Recreate the feel and motion of JetBrains CLion IDE: colors, easing curves, timings.
summary: Definition of done for a web page that recreates the JetBrains CLion IDE look and feel: Darcula dark theme colors, easing curves, animation timings, and UI layout. Verified via DOM computed styles, timing checks, visual scoring, and code checks.

checks.title: Page has no console errors
checks.criteria: No console error messages are logged after page load

checks.title: Editor background is panel color #252526
checks.criteria: Computed background-color of the editor equals #252526

checks.title: Sidebar background is panel color #252526
checks.criteria: Computed background-color of the sidebar equals #252526

checks.title: Sidebar width is 240px
checks.criteria: Computed width of the sidebar is 240px

checks.title: Status bar height is 24px
checks.criteria: Computed height of the status bar is 24px

checks.title: Run button accent color is #007ACC
checks.criteria: Computed background-color of the run button equals #007acc

checks.title: Run button hover transition is 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)
checks.criteria: Computed transition of the run button contains 150ms and cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)

checks.title: Run button hover background changes to hover color
checks.criteria: Run button background changes to hover color within 150-250ms

checks.title: Font family is JetBrains Mono
checks.criteria: Computed font-family of body contains JetBrains Mono

checks.title: Tooltip appears after 500ms hover delay
checks.criteria: Tooltip becomes visible after 500-900ms of hovering

checks.title: Overall visual matches CLion Darcula theme
checks.criteria: Screenshot visually matches JetBrains CLion Darcula dark theme with correct colors, spacing, and layout

environment.rationale: This is a web UI recreation of a desktop IDE theme; it runs in a headless Chromium browser via Playwright. No native desktop, macOS, or GPU is required.
